title: Propagation Delay
text: Model loop delay, latency, pulse delay, 2 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough; {Initial output} sets the initial value for output signal, {Run at fixed time intervals} sets the option to execute block at fixed rate and {Sample time} sets the output sample time. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Initial output
params.values: Initial value for output signal 0 (default) | scalar

params.name: Run at fixed time intervals
params.values: Option to execute block at fixed rate off (default) | on
